headline: US Dollar Reaches Four-Week High Against Vietnamese Dong
summary: The US dollar rose against the Vietnamese dong in Monday morning trading, touching its highest exchange rate level since October 26.
why: The USD/VND exchange rate influences Vietnam's foreign trade competitiveness, foreign currency reserves, and import costs.

impacts.name: Vietnamese Dong
impacts.why: The dong weakened against the US dollar to its lowest point in four weeks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strengthening US dollar demand pushed exchange rates against the Vietnamese dong to a four-week high.
